arguments.question: Across ANET, QQQ, MU, META and NVDA, assess 21/63-session geopolitical and trade-policy transmission channels using available primary/policy materials. Identify only documented restrictions, supply-chain or cross-border demand risks and distinguish facts from scenarios; specify which symbols are directly versus indirectly exposed. Stop after the latest material policy source; state evidence gaps.
arguments.decision_impact: Could identify a market-wide or semiconductor/networking-specific policy risk that changes conditional assessments or requires review conditions.
